name: home-gardening
summary: Gardeners mow, prune, plant and care for people's gardens.
description: Each visit or job is paid once it is done, and gardeners often come every week or two; not landscaping or building, which are paid in stages, nor felling trees.

description.description: The garden work, in the writer's words: what needs doing, or what the gardener does, and how.

price.description: Each price the gardener charges: per hour or per visit, with a count for a pack, such as 4 visits, or with no per for a whole job, or the lowest one starts from; in a request, the most the client would pay.

jobs.description: The kinds of job: mowing is cutting and edging lawns; pruning is cutting back hedges, shrubs and small trees; planting is planting and sowing, and readying the soil for it; leaves is raking and clearing fallen leaves; watering is watering plants, as while the client is away; clearing is cutting back a garden left to grow over; waste removal is taking cuttings and green waste away.

visitHours.description: How long one visit lasts, or the shortest and the longest, such as 2 to 3.

gardenArea.description: About how big the garden is, in square metres, such as 80 for 10 by 8 metres; left out when the client gives no measure.

tools.description: Who brings the tools, such as the mower.

base.description: The area the gardener works in: anywhere in the circle.

hours.description: When the gardener works, each week.

time.description: When the job, or the first visit, is wanted: a time, or a span to fit it in, or the span the work lasts, as watering while the client is away.

photos.description: Photos of the garden and what it needs.

pastWork.description: Photos of gardens the gardener has worked on.

onTime.description: Whether the gardener came at the time agreed.

done.description: Whether the work was done as agreed.

paid.description: Whether the client paid as agreed, once the work was done.
